title: CppCon 2015: Herb Sutter "Writing Good C++14... By Default"
summary: Herb Sutter's CppCon 2015 plenary on writing safe, modern C++ by default using the C++ Core Guidelines. It includes a demo of lifetime-checking static analysis tooling.
why: HN cites it in C++ versus Rust safety debates for its lifetime profile demo, and recommends it as a modern C++ talk.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: Take a look at Herb Sutter's CppCon talk this year
